key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:2529E
name: interpret_command_stream
description: Walks a zero-terminated stream of command records, decoding each record's flag bits and dispatching the nested entries it points to. On exit it merges the final high flag bit into a state byte of the caller's context block.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:252B2
name: parse_table_indexed_records
description: Parses a zero-terminated record stream, taking each record's word from a table indexed by a stored byte and testing its bits to decide whether to continue. Entries with the flag set skip over their payload bytes.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:252C6
name: dispatch_flagged_command_records
description: Processes a stream of flagged records: when a record's high bit is clear it calls an unnamed routine and merges that result into the state byte, otherwise it walks the entries and skips payload bytes. The routine ends by writing the state byte back.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:2530A
name: advance_command_records
description: Steps through a zero-terminated record stream, testing bits of a table-looked-up word for each record and skipping the payload of entries whose flag is clear. It merges the low bits of a stored byte into the state byte before returning.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:25316
name: mirror_and_offset_vertex
description: Computes a point by taking a base vector, subtracting a delta built from a scaled offset table entry, and negating the axes selected by flag bits. The three resulting components are written into a local buffer.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:25386
name: store_flagged_vertex_record
description: Shifts three input components by a count held in a register when the zero flag is clear, then writes them to the output with sign changes chosen by flag bits. It then continues the record walk that follows the vertex data.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:253A8
name: write_flagged_vertex_then_scan
description: Writes three components into an output block after applying sign flags from a control byte, then runs the record loop that consumes the following command bytes. The final flag byte is merged into the state byte before returning.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:253E2
name: stub_empty_routine
description: The recovered body is a bare return with no state changes, memory writes or I/O, so the routine is an empty stub despite its listed instruction count.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:25418
name: stub_empty_routine
description: The recovered body is a bare return with no state changes, memory writes or I/O, so the routine is an empty stub despite its listed instruction count.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:2545C
name: stub_empty_routine
description: The recovered body is a bare return with no state changes, memory writes or I/O, so the routine is an empty stub despite its listed instruction count.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:25486
name: swap_and_negate_matrix_columns
description: Exchanges the second and third entries of each row of a 3x3 matrix of 16-bit values, then negates the first entry of every row. It works in place on the block the address register points to.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:254BE
name: transpose_matrix_words
description: Transposes a 3x3 block of 16-bit values in place by exchanging each off-diagonal pair, leaving the diagonal entries unchanged.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:254CE
name: multiply_vector_by_matrix
description: Shifts three 32-bit components right until they fit a fixed range, multiplies them by the 3x3 matrix at the argument pointer in fixed-point arithmetic, and stores the scaled results into the state block.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:25528
name: transform_and_store_vertex_block
description: Stores a 32-bit vector with its sign words, runs the next transform stage, then multiplies three values from the returned block by a 3x3 matrix and writes the results back.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:255B0
name: transform_vertex_coordinates
description: Multiplies 16-bit vertex coordinates from the returned block by the 3x3 matrix in fixed-point arithmetic, after shifting a normalized position into range. The products are shifted back into 32-bit storage in the destination structure.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:25794
name: multiply_vector_by_transpose
description: Shifts three 32-bit components right until they fit a fixed range, then multiplies them by the 3x3 matrix read in transposed index order. The products are stored into the state block.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:257EE
name: transform_vector_then_copy_block
description: Scales three components by a count derived from the caller's parameter and multiplies them by a 3x3 matrix in transposed order. It then copies nine 16-bit words from a later part of the structure to the start of it.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:2586A
name: normalize_vector_then_transform
description: Copies nine 16-bit words from a later part of the structure to its start and sets a flag byte. It then finds how far three 32-bit components must be shifted to fit a fixed range, applies that shift and multiplies the result by a 3x3 matrix.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:25946
name: stub_empty_routine
description: The recovered body is a bare return with no state changes, memory writes or I/O, so the routine is an empty stub despite its listed instruction count.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:2598C
name: insert_sorted_list_entry
description: Walks a linked list of 12-byte records ordered by a 16-bit key until it finds the insertion point. It then either adds a new node taken from the free-space pointer or updates the matching node, storing the key, a flag byte and three extra words.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:25A08
name: resume_sorted_list_insert
description: Continues walking a sorted node list from a given position, allocating a node from the free-space pointer when the key does not match the current entry. It then stores the key, a flag byte and three extra words.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:25A22
name: insert_node_and_scan_list
description: Allocates a node from the free-space pointer and links it after a given position, storing a key and a flag byte. It then advances through the list until it reaches a node whose key is at or above the threshold.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:25A46
name: link_new_node_with_payload
description: When the zero flag is clear, allocates a node from the free-space pointer and links it after the current one, copying the flag word from its neighbour. It then stores the key, a flag byte and three extra words into the node.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:25A7C
name: insert_or_update_list_node
description: Walks a linked list of keyed nodes to the insertion point for a given key, then either links in a new node or updates the matching one. Three extra words are stored into the chosen node.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:25ABE
name: store_node_key_and_payload
description: Optionally updates the link of the current node when the zero flag is set, then writes a key into the selected node and stores three extra words after it.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:25AD2
name: link_node_and_set_flag
description: When the zero flag is clear, allocates a node from the free-space pointer and links it after the current one with the given key. It then sets a flag byte and stores three extra words into the selected node.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:25B06
name: insert_keyed_node_with_flags
description: Searches a list ordered by a 16-bit key for where a new key belongs, allocating a node only when the key is not already present. It stores three extra words and sets the node's flag byte and link field.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:25B58
name: mark_list_node_at_threshold
description: Follows next-node links until it reaches a node whose key is not below the threshold, stopping early if a node lacks the active flag bit. It then writes a flag byte and a fixed link value into that node.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:25B7C
name: reset_list_node_flags
description: Walks a linked list of keyed nodes, tagging the nodes in the key range with a fixed flag word, and links a new node for a key that falls between existing entries.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:25B9A
name: tag_nodes_and_insert_key
description: Advances through keyed list nodes while their keys are not above the given key, tagging the nodes it passes with a fixed flag word. It inserts a new node with the key when no matching entry exists.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:25BEC
name: insert_key_and_mark_range
description: Inserts a node for the given key, allocating from the free-space pointer when the key does not match the current node. It then writes the payload words and tags the following nodes with a flag byte until the key range is exhausted.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:25C14
name: initialize_and_clear_nodes
description: When the zero flag is clear, allocates a new node and links it after the current one with the key. It then walks the rest of the list, setting a fixed flag word on nodes that are still flagged active.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:25C54
name: transform_state_vector_by_matrix
description: Multiplies a 16-bit vector held in the state block by the 3x3 matrix whose pointer is stored there, writing three results back. A second set of 32-bit components is processed alongside it using the same matrix.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:25CFA
name: transform_vector_with_adaptive_shift
description: Shifts three 32-bit components right to fit a fixed range, multiplies them by the 3x3 matrix whose pointer is stored in the state block, and then shifts the products by a count derived from the caller's scale.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:25D78
name: store_scaled_vector_components
description: Writes three 32-bit values into consecutive state-block fields after shifting them by a variable count. The sign words of three other values are stored beside them.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:25D9E
name: transform_stored_vector_transpose
description: Multiplies a 16-bit vector from the state block by the matrix whose pointer is stored there, reading the matrix in transposed order, and writes three products back. The 32-bit components are then processed the same way.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:25E50
name: transform_vector_transposed_shifted
description: Shifts three 32-bit components right to fit a fixed range, multiplies them by the 3x3 matrix read in transposed order, then shifts the products by a count derived from the caller's scale.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:25EDA
name: store_scaled_vector_at_offset
description: Writes three 32-bit components into state-block fields after shifting them by a variable count, followed by three sign words in the next fields.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:25F00
name: find_vector_normalization_shift
description: Finds a shift count that brings two sets of 32-bit vector components into a fixed range, shifts the components by it, and returns the shifted pair of results.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:25F5A
name: multiply_rows_with_shift
description: Multiplies three components by two rows of the matrix pointed to by the argument, shifts each product by a count derived from the caller's scale, and returns the two results packed together.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:25FD6
name: shift_pair_right
description: Returns two 32-bit inputs, each shifted right by the same variable count, packed together into one 64-bit result.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:25FF6
name: compute_scaled_position_delta
description: Subtracts a saved 64-bit position from the current one, shifts the difference right one bit at a time by the given count, and dot-products the result with a stored matrix row to form a 16-bit component.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:26074
name: initialize_object_context
description: Stores the caller's parameter registers into the state block, selects an entry from a table using a byte in the object record, and sets the object's current position by adding its stored offset to its base position with carry propagation.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:26114
name: scan_table_for_matching_object
description: Stores six vector values and a status into the state block, then scans a table of object records downward for entries with a matching type byte and an active flag, handling each match.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:26178
name: process_object_pair_loop
description: Sets a status byte in the state block and runs the object-record loop, which handles records whose flags are set by transforming their stored positions.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:26188
name: transform_active_object_pair
description: When the active flag is set and the record's type differs from the reference, transforms the pair's stored position with a 3x3 matrix and stores the results back in the state block.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:2618C
name: process_object_records
description: Walks the object record list, skipping inactive records and transforming the positions of those flagged as active against a reference object, then stores the results in the state block.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:261D0
name: compute_relative_object_position
description: Compares an object's type byte with the reference type and, when they differ, computes the object's position relative to the stored reference by adding or subtracting six vector components with carry. The results are passed to the next stage.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:26242
name: scan_object_record_pairs
description: Clears a status byte, then runs the object-record loop, which for active records computes dot products between stored matrix rows and the reference vector and stores the results.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:26266
name: set_status_and_scan_objects
description: Sets a status byte from a flag on the current object record and runs the object-record loop that follows.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:2627E
name: clear_status_and_scan_objects
description: Clears a status byte in the state block and runs the object-record loop that follows.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:26290
name: compute_offset_from_reference
description: Looks up a record through a table and, when its type matches the reference, computes the difference between the stored position and that record's position component by component. The six results are passed to the next stage.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:2631A
name: clear_status_and_scan_objects
description: Clears a status byte in the state block and runs the object-record loop that follows.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:2633E
name: reset_offsets_and_scan_objects
description: When the second record's active flag is set, calls the unnamed routine with six zero values, then clears the status byte and runs the object-record loop.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:26384
name: clear_status_and_scan_objects
description: Clears a status byte in the state block and runs the object-record loop that follows.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:263AC
name: negate_offset_and_scan_objects
description: Compares an object's type byte with the reference; on a match it sets a status byte, otherwise it passes the negated six-component offset to that routine and then runs the object-record loop.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:26420
name: clear_status_and_scan_objects
description: Clears a status byte in the state block and runs the object-record loop that follows.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:26448
name: clear_status_and_scan_objects
description: Clears a status byte in the state block and runs the object-record loop that follows.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:2647A
name: process_object_records
description: Walks the object record list, skipping inactive records and transforming the positions of those flagged as active against a reference object, then stores the results in the state block.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:264B8
name: store_transformed_result_vector
description: Calls that routine for a scaled component and stores the returned value and two others into the state block. When a flag bit is set on an active record, it multiplies the result by the stored matrix into three 16-bit outputs.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:264C4
name: halve_stored_pair
description: Reads two 32-bit values from the state block, halves each with an arithmetic shift, and returns their 16-bit results packed together.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:26546
name: transform_object_vertex_matrix
description: For an active record, multiplies a stored position by the 3x3 matrix held in that record and writes the 16-bit products to the state block. A 32-bit companion value is kept alongside the results.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:265F6
name: transform_vector_with_stored_matrix
description: Multiplies a 16-bit vector from the argument registers by a 3x3 matrix in the argument block and stores three products in the state block. When a flag bit is set it multiplies them again by the stored matrix.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:26786
name: check_object_bounds_and_normalize
description: Tests an object record's flag and the sign and magnitude of three coordinates against a bound taken from the state block, returning early when the test fails. When it passes, it shifts the coordinates into a fixed range.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:267D2
name: normalize_and_test_cross_product
description: Finds a shift count that brings three values into range, shifts them, and computes a cross product of two stored vectors. It returns early when the magnitude of that product is not below a bound.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:26896
name: prepare_shifted_projection_inputs
description: Looks up a shift value in the state block and applies it to three stored coordinates, then builds a small block of fixed values on the stack for the following stage.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:2692E
name: transform_point_and_vector_pair
description: Multiplies three input components by the 3x3 matrix in the argument record and stores the products. A second set of values is then transformed through the same matrix.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:26A58
name: parse_render_command_stream
description: Parses a zero-terminated stream of command records, reading each record's flag bits and resolving table entries through a pointer in the state block before dispatching to the next record handler.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:26A92
name: dispatch_render_command_records
description: Continues the record stream with the same flag tests. For records that reference table entries it builds a local block of values from the table before dispatching.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:26A9C
name: build_indexed_command_block
description: Handles a record that references an indexed table entry, building a local block with fixed words and the record's parameters before passing it on.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:26AD2
name: stub_empty_routine
description: The recovered body is a bare return with no state changes, memory writes or I/O, so the routine is an empty stub despite its listed instruction count.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:26AD4
name: check_command_bounds_then_parse
description: Calls an unnamed routine and compares its result with a bound derived from the state block, then continues the command record stream when the value is in range.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:26AFC
name: check_command_bounds_then_parse
description: Calls an unnamed routine and compares its result with a bound derived from the state block, then continues the command record stream when the value is in range.

name: scan_byte_list_within_bounds
description: Walks a zero-terminated byte list, passing each entry to an unnamed routine and comparing the result with a lower and an upper bound. Entries inside the bounds are stored as three words in the state block, and the routine returns zero at the terminator.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:26CE0
name: scan_byte_list_within_bounds
description: Walks a zero-terminated byte list and passes each entry to an unnamed routine, storing three words into the state block for entries whose results fall within the bounds. It returns zero when the list ends.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:26D02
name: store_entries_within_bounds
description: Loops over a zero-terminated byte list, storing three words into the state block for each entry in range and stopping when a value falls below the lower bound. It returns zero at the list terminator.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:26D18
name: lookup_signed_table_components
description: Looks up a pair of 16-bit words through a table index, applies the sign of the entry's first byte, and scales the result by the difference between two stored values.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:26D4E
name: compute_table_entry_dot_product
description: Looks up a 16-bit table entry, shifts its components by the difference between two stored values, and dot-products them with the difference between a stored vector and the state, returning the result.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:26D92
name: divide_dot_product_by_scale
description: Computes a dot product of a vector difference with stored coefficients, then divides it by a scale computed from those coefficients. It returns the quotient and remainder packed together, with a saturating fallback when the scale is zero.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:26DD0
name: compute_xor_sign_result
description: XORs a 16-bit value with the high word of another and returns a 32-bit result combining the XOR with a sign mask, flipped to form a 16-bit mask.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:26DDE
name: check_extent_against_bounds
description: Stores six 32-bit values into the state block, then compares the object's extent with three coordinate pairs and returns early when they lie outside the bounds.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:26E3E
name: scale_stored_vectors_by_magnitude
description: Finds how far a magnitude must be shifted to fit a fixed range, shifts six stored 32-bit values by that count, and leaves them scaled for the following computation.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:26E78
name: shift_and_accumulate_vector_components
description: Shifts a set of six 32-bit state values and a pair of object components right by a common count, combining the shifted bits so both sides share one scale.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:26FFA
name: store_scaled_distance_and_exponent
description: Scales a 32-bit input by a shift stored in the state block, stores the resulting 64-bit distance and a normalised scale with its exponent back into the state block, and selects a status code.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:2700E
name: store_scaled_distance_state
description: Scales a 32-bit input by the shift stored in the state block, stores the value and a normalised scale into the state block, and copies saved vector values into a second set of fields.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:27034
name: store_scaled_position_and_flags
description: Normalises a 32-bit input by its shift count, stores the value and scale into the state block with status codes, and copies several saved vector words into the stored position block.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:2708E
name: wait_then_copy_state_block
description: Waits until a busy flag in the state block clears, then copies eight 32-bit words and a 16-bit value from the argument block into the state block and clears a status byte.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:270AC
name: reset_state_to_defaults
description: Calls one unnamed routine, then copies eight 32-bit constants from fixed data into the state block, stores a fixed 16-bit value and sets the status byte.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:270B2
name: reset_state_to_defaults
description: Copies eight 32-bit constants from fixed data into the state block, stores a fixed 16-bit value and sets the status byte.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:270D2
name: wait_for_busy_flags
description: Spins until a busy flag in the state block and a second flag in global data both clear, then returns.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:270E2
name: copy_ten_word_blocks
description: Copies 800 blocks of ten 32-bit words from one buffer to another in a loop, then returns its two register arguments packed into a 64-bit result.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:2710C
name: copy_offset_word_blocks
description: Copies blocks of ten 32-bit words from one buffer to another, starting at a fixed offset into each buffer and looping over thirty-two blocks.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:27160
name: store_registers_in_state
description: Sets a status byte to all ones and stores eight 32-bit register arguments into consecutive state-block fields.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:2716E
name: wait_and_reset_busy_state
description: Clears a status byte, waits for a busy flag to clear, stores a fixed 16-bit value and clears another byte, calls one unnamed routine, then waits for the busy flag again.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:27178
name: store_word_in_two_fields
description: Stores a 16-bit argument into two fixed fields of the state block.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:27182
name: swap_display_buffer_pointers
description: Copies eight 32-bit words between two state-block areas, then swaps two buffer pointers held in global data and toggles a global byte. The copper list pointer register is also written.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:271CA
name: copy_primary_buffer_pointer
description: Copies one global buffer pointer into another so that both refer to the same buffer.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:271D6
name: copy_primary_buffer_pointer
description: Copies one global buffer pointer into another so that both refer to the same buffer.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:271E2
name: halt_in_infinite_loop
description: Contains only an infinite loop with no exit, so once entered it never returns.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:271FC
name: wait_for_counter_then_set
description: Spins while a global counter is positive, then stores one into it before returning.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:2720E
name: wait_for_counter_then_set
description: Spins while a global counter is positive, then stores two into it before returning.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:27320
name: fetch_pending_byte_value
description: Reads a pending byte from the state block and, if one is set, clears it and returns a value looked up through a table selected by two flag bytes. A negative pending value returns the stored byte directly.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:27348
name: read_and_clear_pending_byte
description: Clears a flag byte in the state block and returns a second byte stored beside it.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:27352
name: store_pending_byte_and_flag
description: Stores a byte argument in the state block and sets a flag byte to all ones.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:2735E
name: fetch_pending_byte_or_zero
description: Returns zero when a count byte in the state block is zero. Otherwise it clears the pending flag and returns a stored value, looked up through a table when the count is positive.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:2736C
name: clear_count_byte
description: Clears a count byte in the state block.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:27422
name: setup_graphics_interrupts
description: Opens the graphics library through the exec library and installs an interrupt server. It zeroes a 32-word state region and programs the display window, bitplane modulo, DMA control, colour registers, copper list pointer and interrupt enable bits.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:27584
name: wait_and_call_handlers
description: Waits until a busy flag in the state block clears, then calls two library routines through offsets in global data. Interrupt enable bits are written as part of this sequence.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:275B8
name: invoke_interrupt_handler
description: Calls one library routine through a pointer from the state block, sets a few globals and calls another library vector, storing its returned value in global data. Interrupt enable bits are written.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:275EE
name: remove_interrupt_server_and_close
description: Removes an interrupt server and restores the interrupt vector through the exec library, closes a library, then writes the copper pointer, DMA control and interrupt enable registers.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:27666
name: wait_then_load_colour_palette
description: Waits until the raster position reaches a threshold, then copies eight words into the colour palette registers starting at colour register zero. It then sets a global interrupt-related value.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:276AA
name: process_input_and_update_state
description: Updates per-frame state: when a flag is set it copies words into blitter and colour registers and advances a frame counter. It also reads the joystick, mouse and button registers before calling other routines.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:277BE
name: advance_blit_or_finish
description: Decrements a blit counter and, while it stays non-zero, updates the blitter control value and advances a memory address. Once the counter reaches zero it clears the counter and re-enables interrupts through the interrupt enable register.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:277F0
name: advance_blit_destination_row
description: Sets blitter control and destination values, advances a destination pointer by a fixed plane stride, halves a counter in the state block, and writes the interrupt enable register.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:27826
name: clear_flag_and_enable_interrupts
description: Clears a 16-bit flag in the state block and writes a fixed value with the set bit to the interrupt enable register.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:27864
name: start_io_request_if_valid
description: Stores two routine results in global data and, when the second is non-zero, passes that request to an exec library routine. On success it marks the request with a fixed value and submits it.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:278BC
name: finish_io_request_and_close
description: When an I/O request exists, sends its pending command through the exec library if the request has a pending field set, then runs the close routine for the request.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:2790A
name: update_flag_from_record
description: Checks a record's type byte and, for one fixed type, sets a flag in global data from the high bit of another byte. It clears related globals and otherwise returns the record pointer.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:2794A
name: clear_record_status_fields
description: Zeroes three byte fields and one word field relative to the argument pointer, then returns zero.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:279BE
name: allocate_exec_message_node
description: Allocates a signal and a memory node through exec library vectors and fills in its type, priority and message fields. It returns the node, or zero when allocation fails.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:27A42
name: release_port_and_signal
description: When given a node, removes its port from the exec system, clears two status bytes, frees its signal and frees its memory through the exec library.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:27A86
name: reset_state_pair_to_defaults
description: Sets one state word to zero and another to a fixed value of 512.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:27A8C
name: store_two_state_words
description: Stores two argument values into two 16-bit state-block fields.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:27A96
name: load_two_state_words
description: Returns two 16-bit state-block words packed together into one result.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:27AA4
name: read_state_low_bits
description: Returns the two low bits of a state byte. The routine is reached only as gap code in the static flow.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:27AAE
name: clamp_position_to_screen_area
description: Increments a counter, then clamps the sum of a stored position and the arguments to a 320 by 200 area. It stores the clamped position and derives a 16-bit value from it.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:27BDE
name: read_joystick_axes_with_deadzone
description: Reads two stored axis values, removes a dead zone of 300 around zero, and clamps them to plus or minus 700 before combining them with stored direction flags. The joystick data register and fire-button register are also read.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:27CEE
name: fill_state_word_with_ones
description: Stores all ones into a 16-bit state word.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:27D98
name: copy_table_into_record_list
description: Sets a state word to all ones, skips to the end of a list of five-word records, then copies entries from a global table into the list until a terminator marks the end.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:27DA2
name: append_records_from_pointer
description: Skips to the end of a list of five-word records, then copies records from the argument pointer into the list until a terminator, marking each new record with a terminator value.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:27DC6
name: remove_matching_record
description: Finds the first record whose key matches the argument and shifts the following records down over it, stopping at the list terminator.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:27DEC
name: append_offset_record
description: Appends a five-word record to the list, storing coordinates derived from the arguments with the lower bounds clamped to zero.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:27DF2
name: append_offset_record
description: Appends a five-word record to the list, storing coordinates derived from the arguments with the lower bounds clamped to zero, using a separate offset for each axis.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:27E30
name: set_bitplane_pointers
description: Stores an argument address and three further addresses spaced 8000 bytes apart into the bitplane pointer fields, then writes a fixed series of display values into the following fields.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:27F5C
name: reset_state_and_call_vectors
description: Clears a block of state fields and then runs a sequence of calls through a library vector table, storing a return address in a state word before each call.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:27FC6
name: reset_state_then_dispatch_calls
description: Stores the argument into a state word, clears several state fields, and makes a sequence of library vector calls. A nonzero state word leads to further calls and a flag bit being set.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:28056
name: run_timed_library_sequence
description: Runs a loop with a fixed count of 35000 that makes library vector calls, then resets several state fields, sets a flag byte and makes further library calls.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:28104
name: initialize_runtime_state
description: Initialises several global pointers and flag bytes, calls a series of routines, then runs a loop that advances a 32-bit counter until the state is ready.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:284AC
name: format_signed_decimal_string
description: Writes a signed 32-bit integer as decimal ASCII digits into a buffer, placing a minus sign first for negative values. Each digit is extracted by subtracting descending powers of ten.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:2852C
name: format_decimal_digits_unrolled
description: Converts a 32-bit value into decimal digits written to a buffer, using repeated subtraction of descending powers of ten in an unrolled sequence.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:28610
name: walk_text_characters_in_range
description: Walks a zero-terminated text string, comparing each character code with fixed ranges and calling two unnamed routines for characters in range. It is reached only as gap code in the static flow.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:2862A
name: format_nibbles_as_characters
description: Converts the eight 4-bit nibbles of a 32-bit value into character codes, one per nibble, writing them to a buffer and terminating it with zero.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:2864C
name: read_edited_text_line
description: Reads a line of characters into a buffer, removing the last character on backspace or delete, accepting printable characters and ending on carriage return. The buffer length is counted from the initial text first.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:286D2
name: read_printable_text_input
description: Reads characters into a buffer, accepting printable characters, removing the last one on backspace or delete, and stopping at carriage return.

description: When a flag is set, adds scaled per-axis increments to three position fields after clamping the scale to 32767. It then clamps a second value, compares a component with a threshold of fourteen and calls an unnamed routine to adjust the matching components.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:28998
name: damp_components_by_shift_level
description: When a component's magnitude exceeds fourteen, calls an unnamed routine for a level, then subtracts shifted fractions of six coordinate fields. The shift count is taken from that level.

name: damp_coordinates_by_level
description: Compares an input with its negated bound and, when the magnitude exceeds fourteen, calls an unnamed routine for a level. It then subtracts shifted fractions of the coordinates and rebuilds them from the results.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:28A68
name: damp_components_by_shift_level
description: Compares a stored component with a bound and, when its magnitude exceeds fourteen, calls an unnamed routine to get a level. It then subtracts shifted fractions of six coordinates.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:28B34
name: damp_column_by_shift_level
description: Reads a component at a different offset; when its magnitude exceeds fourteen, calls an unnamed routine and subtracts shifted fractions from three coordinate fields.

name: derive_scaled_state_fields
description: Stores one state field shifted right by three into another field, and stores the negated second field shifted right by two into a third.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:28DB2
name: project_vector_with_clamp
description: Computes three dot products between a stored vector and rows of a 3x3 matrix, storing two of them with the sign reversed where needed. When the third product is negative, the two stored components are clamped to plus or minus 16384.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:28E2E
name: project_vector_with_mask_bits
description: Computes three dot products between a stored vector and matrix rows, storing two of them. When the third product is non-negative, the two stored components are replaced by their high bytes XORed with 16383.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:28EA6
name: compute_scaled_dot_product_component
description: Computes a dot product of a stored vector with two state-block components, shifts it right by 18 bits and stores its negation in another field.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:28ED0
name: update_component_from_matching_record
description: Compares type bytes of two records and, when they match, writes components of the first record derived from the second record's matrix using a 17-bit shift. Further components are written when the argument flag is set.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:28EE2
name: compute_matrix_row_components
description: When the record's active flag is set, halves two stored components. Otherwise it writes one component from a dot product with the second record's matrix, shifted right by 17 bits, and writes two more when the argument flag is set.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:28F0E
name: compute_component_from_matrix_row
description: Writes one component of the record from a dot product with the second record's matrix row, shifted right by 17 bits. When the extra argument is nonzero it also writes two more components.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:28F88
name: divide_normalized_fixed_point
description: Divides a 64-bit fixed-point quantity by a second one, first normalising both by a shift count found from their magnitudes, and returns the shifted quotient components.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:28F98
name: divide_pair_by_normalized_divisor
description: Divides a pair of 32-bit values by a 64-bit divisor after normalising them with a shift count from their magnitudes, and returns the shifted quotient.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:28FEC
name: shift_pair_by_scale_count
description: Shifts two 32-bit inputs right by a count found by repeatedly halving a stored value until it fits a fixed range, and returns them packed together.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:29010
name: call_two_unnamed_routines
description: Calls two unnamed routines in sequence and returns, with no other operations in the recovered body.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:29024
name: transform_vector_pair_by_flag
description: Computes a pair of transformed values from a matrix row and a shifted input, choosing between two paths by a flag on the record. The flagged path calls an unnamed routine and returns scaled dot products.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:290A0
name: add_offsets_to_routine_result
description: Calls one unnamed routine, then adds two 16-bit offset fields from the argument block, shifted into place, to its two 32-bit results and returns both.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:290F0
name: subtract_offsets_when_types_differ
description: When one record's type byte differs from the other record's type field but matches its neighbour, calls an unnamed routine and subtracts the stored offsets from its result. Otherwise it returns the negated stored offsets.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:29110
name: return_negated_offsets
description: Returns the two stored offset fields negated and packed together.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:2911E
name: compute_position_delta_or_stored
description: Returns a stored 64-bit value unless a mode byte equals one. In that mode it calls an unnamed routine and a library vector with the record's position fields, then returns the position differences shifted right by ten bits, or zero when a flag is set.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:29136
name: compute_position_delta_scaled
description: When a flag bit on the record is clear, calls an unnamed routine and a library vector with the record's position fields, then returns the position differences shifted right by ten bits. Otherwise it returns zero.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:291AC
name: normalize_vector_magnitude
description: Measures the magnitude of a 64-bit vector and shifts it left or right until it falls within a fixed range, returning the scaled components together with their shift count.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:291E2
name: store_normalized_record_state
description: Normalises the input values to fit a fixed range, stores four results into the record and updates a countdown byte in it. When the countdown underflows it calls an unnamed routine and stores the derived position components.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:2928E
name: adjust_record_from_timer
description: When a flag is set, calls an unnamed routine and conditionally adjusts state fields from stored values and the record's timing field. It then writes derived position components back into the record.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:29306
name: normalize_vector_magnitude
description: Measures the magnitude of a 64-bit vector and shifts it left or right until it falls within a fixed range, returning the scaled components together with their shift count.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:2933C
name: update_record_from_normalized_input
description: Normalises the input values to fit a fixed range and stores the results in the record. When a state field is set, it compares timing values to decide whether to clear record flags.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:293F6
name: offset_and_store_position_components
description: Adds three shifted offsets to three 16-bit input values, shifts the sums left by a bounded count and stores them as 32-bit positions in the record. It returns an unnamed routine result shifted by the same count.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:29442
name: shift_pair_right_by_count
description: Shifts two 32-bit inputs right by a count taken from the argument register and returns them packed together.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:2944E
name: record_undecompiled_routine
description: The decompiler produced no pseudo-code for this routine, so only its facts are known: it calls one unnamed routine and is called from one unnamed routine.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:29458
name: accumulate_record_position
description: When the record has a nonzero offset, copies type and flag bytes from the reference record depending on flag bits. It then adds unnamed routine-computed deltas to the record's three position fields.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:29486
name: add_64bit_deltas_to_record
description: Adds two unnamed routine-computed 64-bit deltas into the record's six 32-bit position and velocity fields, propagating carries between the words.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:29504
name: scale_record_components
description: Multiplies three stored components by a 16-bit scale derived from the argument, negates them according to the input signs, stores the results in the record, then shifts an unnamed routine result by a count.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:29568
name: scale_record_coordinates
description: Multiplies three coordinate fields by a scaled factor, with sign handling for the argument, then stores the results in the record.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:295F8
name: normalize_and_project_vector
description: Shifts three input components right by the smallest count that brings their magnitudes into range, then computes a dot product of the shifted components with a matrix row.
